body:
### Complete changelog

  * [#54792](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/54792) - Enforce the `@AuthenticationContext` step-up policy for `@TestSecurity` tests
  * [#57046](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/57046) - Occasional CI failure: KafkaConnectorTest
  * [#57478](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/57478) - Allow extensions to contribute persistence unit managed classes by package
  * [#57574](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/57574) - quarkus 3.40.1: dev UI not working
  * [#58136](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58136) - OpenTelemetry resource customization drops service entity when telemetry service name differs from application name
  * [#58138](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58138) - Preserve OpenTelemetry service entity with explicit service name
  * [#58323](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58323) - Cache observer resolution in ArC
  * [#58349](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58349) - Config mapping error in extension subproject
  * [#58376](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58376) - Do not load local Gradle extensions as application archives in IDE launches
  * [#58380](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58380) - CacheControlDelegate mis-parses quoted field lists in Cache-Control
  * [#58381](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58381) - Parse quoted field lists in Cache-Control headers correctly
  * [#58415](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58415) - Qute: {#if a && b || c} is false when a is false and c is true
  * [#58416](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58416) - Continue a Qute #if condition after an && short-circuit
  * [#58436](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58436) - Take the inputs of the Gradle quarkusBuild task from the tasks that build the application parts
  * [#58476](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58476) - Make the Gradle tasks consuming the application model reusable from a build cache in another checkout
  * [#58503](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58503) - Fix dead fragment links by replacing relative links with absolute ones
  * [#58506](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58506) - Kafka Streams Dev UI: the object URL created for the topology download is never released
  * [#58507](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58507) - Release the object URL after downloading the Kafka Streams topology
  * [#58526](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58526) - Fix a test and make images consistent in tests
  * [#58527](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58527) - Make large DTO in test larger as ASM is now more efficient
  * [#58528](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58528) - Redis pub/sub: subscribe() from an event loop never completes, its SUBSCRIBE confirmation is dropped and the connection stays subscribed (3.40)
  * [#58529](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58529) - Agroal Dev UI: object URLs created for binary cell download links are never released
  * [#58530](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58530) - Fix flaky KafkaConnectorTest
  * [#58531](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58531) - Create the Agroal binary download URL on click and revoke it
  * [#58541](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58541) - Rename quarkus-test-spring to quarkus-spring-test
  * [#58545](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58545) - Spring Test - Rename module from test-spring to spring-test
  * [#58546](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58546) - Native executable answers HTTP/1.0 requests with 501 Not Implemented in 4.0.0.CR1 (JVM and 3.x native return 200)
  * [#58550](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58550) - OIDC: Fix back-channel logout requests hanging on unexpected errors
  * [#58553](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58553) - Fix HTTP/1.0 returning 501 in native mode
  * [#58556](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58556) - Install the Redis pub/sub reply handler before sending SUBSCRIBE
  * [#58564](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58564) - Undeprecate recorders-to-services-migration.adoc
  * [#58570](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58570) - Fix typo in WebAuthn register challenge error message
  * [#58572](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58572) - Revisit #57872: manage the latest version of Woodstox to avoid downgrading for Quarkus CXF; manage also Woodstox dependency stax2-api
  * [#58573](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58573) - REST Client: OpenTelemetry client span loses its parent when the body is an `InputStream` and the call is made outside a Vert.x context
  * [#58577](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58577) - Fix worker thread leak on client disconnect in VertxOutputStream
  * [#58584](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58584) - Remove ignored generator names from Hibernate test mappings
  * [#58592](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58592) - Bump elasticsearch-opensource-components.version from 9.4.9 to 9.4.10
  * [#58596](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58596) - oidc-mtls test realm has the "users" key twice, so the first users list is ignored
  * [#58597](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58597) - Remove the duplicate users list from the oidc-mtls test realm
  * [#58599](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58599) - Make SpiffeClient request timeout configurable
  * [#58600](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58600) - Fix typo in the WebAuthn security guide
  * [#58601](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58601) - Update Hibernate Accessor to 0.1.0 / Update Hibernate Validator to 9.2.0.Final
  * [#58609](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58609) - Fix typos in comments and READMEs
  * [#58612](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58612) - Remove the virtual thread --enable-preview leftovers, virtual threads are final in Java 21
  * [#58616](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58616) - Remove guide workarounds for problems that the shipped versions fixed
  * [#58618](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58618) - Remove the virtual thread --enable-preview leftovers
  * [#58622](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58622) - Remove guide workarounds for problems that the shipped versions fixed
  * [#58625](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58625) - docs: fix doubled words in guides
  * [#58639](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58639) - Advertise HTTP/3 via Alt-Svc over HTTP/2 too
  * [#58646](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58646) - Bump apicurio-registry.version from 3.3.4 to 3.3.5
  * [#58647](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58647) - Don't expose entity fields as filter query params for Spring Data REST
  * [#58659](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58659) - Revert Add devservices-lgtm as conditionalDevDependency to opentelemetry
  * [#58661](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58661) - OIDC DEV UI should fallback to the default password when form field is left empty
  * [#58675](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58675) - Use the public Jackson 3 mapper of the Keycloak admin client
  * [#58676](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58676) - Use the public Jackson 3 mapper of the Keycloak admin client
  * [#58679](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58679) - The jbang wrapper codestart cannot download a JDK
  * [#58680](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58680) - Fix the JDK download of the jbang wrapper codestart
  * [#58691](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58691) - HTTP/3 - Send Alt-Svc ALTSVC frame on HTTP/2 again
  * [#58692](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58692) - Do not retry the OpenShift binary build upload
  * [#58695](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58695) - OIDC Client Registration: prevent double default client registration
  * [#58697](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58697) - Fix class-level `@Tenant` and auth mechanism ignored on generic method overrides
  * [#58705](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58705) - Improve netstat instructions to only look at listen ones
  * [#58710](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58710) - Dev mode does not recover after a failed start when the HTTP listen callback throws SRCFG00015
  * [#58717](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58717) - Use the quickstarts branch matching the version in forks
  * [#58721](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58721) - ArC invokers: NoClassDefFoundError for target beans from a dependency in test/dev mode
  * [#58723](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58723) - Keep the REST client OpenTelemetry parent when coming from outside Vert.x
  * [#58724](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58724) - ArC: fix and validate classloading of async handlers used by invokers
  * [#58725](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58725) - Recognize new GraalVM message for missing native HTTPS support
  * [#58734](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58734) - [4.0] Upgrade Hibernate ORM to 8.0.0.CR2 and Hibernate Reactive to 5.1.0.CR3
  * [#58737](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58737) - Add conditional dependencies to the nodes winning in conflict resolution
  * [#58738](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58738) - Register a Config for Dev mode when the application fails
